purpose: Exploratory minimal semantic appendix ablation; fresh sessions, same five FIFO source counters; not an independent natural-IP replication
schedule: round-major, repetition-major, rotate arms by (round + repetition - 2) modulo 4
feedback_policy: B is unchanged lossless compact raw feedback. Full C retains the existing appendix. Minimal C retains only proved equivalent source groups, event context, two-state scope and separate measured counters. P replaces minimal C with own-trajectory provider-token-matched neutral filler.
failure_policy: After bounded retries, stop that session and retain all costs and last measured coverage as not reached or previously reached. Count/measurement failures stop the session; checker violations remain valid measured DUT outcomes.
measurement_policy: Compile once as shared overhead; each simulation replays seed plus all accepted actions with fresh counters. Report active session wall time and shared setup separately; never charge other sessions' waiting time. Keep every raw DUT counter.
